definitions.meaning: sức bền, khả năng chịu đựng lâu dài

examples: Marathon running requires great endurance.
Regular exercise can improve your endurance over time.

definitions.meaning: khởi động (trước khi tập luyện)

examples: Always warm up for ten minutes before you start running.
The coach told the players to warm up before the match.

definitions.meaning: buổi tập luyện thể dục

examples: She does a one-hour workout at the gym every morning.
His workout includes both cardio and strength training.

definitions.meaning: vận động viên, người chơi thể thao chuyên nghiệp

examples: She is a talented athlete who has won many national competitions.
Professional athletes train several hours a day.

definitions.meaning: giải đấu, cuộc thi đấu thể thao

examples: Our school team reached the final of the basketball tournament.
The tennis tournament attracts players from all over the world.

definitions.meaning: tỉ số, điểm số trong trận đấu
ghi bàn, ghi điểm

examples: The final score was 3–1 in favor of the home team.
He scored two goals in the last ten minutes.

definitions.meaning: huấn luyện viên thể thao

examples: The coach gave the team a motivating speech before the game.
She has been our swimming coach for three years.

definitions.meaning: trọng tài (trong các môn thể thao)

examples: The referee blew the whistle to stop the play.
Players must respect the referee's decisions during the match.

definitions.meaning: chạy nước rút, chạy rất nhanh trong một đoạn ngắn
cú chạy nước rút

examples: She sprinted to the finish line and won the race.
He did several short sprints as part of his training.

definitions.meaning: duỗi, kéo giãn cơ bắp
động tác kéo giãn

examples: It is important to stretch after a long run to avoid muscle soreness.
She held each stretch for thirty seconds.

definitions.meaning: cúp, phần thưởng cho người chiến thắng

examples: The winning team lifted the trophy in front of thousands of fans.
She keeps all her swimming trophies on a shelf in her room.

definitions.meaning: phòng tập thể dục, nhà thi đấu trong nhà

examples: The school gymnasium is used for basketball practice every afternoon.
They built a new gymnasium with modern equipment.

definitions.meaning: dụng cụ, thiết bị thể thao

examples: Make sure you have the right equipment before starting the sport.
The gym recently bought new exercise equipment.

definitions.meaning: đồng đội, thành viên trong cùng một đội

examples: He passed the ball to his teammate who was in a better position.
Good communication between teammates is key to winning.

definitions.meaning: đối thủ, người thi đấu ở phía đối lập

examples: She studied her opponent carefully before the tennis match.
He shook hands with his opponent after the game ended.

definitions.meaning: bài tập tim mạch (như chạy bộ, đạp xe, bơi lội)

examples: She does thirty minutes of cardio every day to stay healthy.
Cycling and swimming are excellent forms of cardio.

definitions.meaning: cơ bắp, bắp thịt

examples: Weightlifting helps you build muscle and increase strength.
Her leg muscles were sore after the long hike.

definitions.meaning: hình phạt, quả phạt đền (trong thể thao)

examples: The player received a penalty for an illegal tackle.
They won the match by scoring in a penalty shootout.

definitions.meaning: đường chạy, đường đua thể thao

examples: The runners lined up at the start of the track.
She trains on the running track three times a week.

definitions.meaning: tạ tay, dụng cụ tập gym hình quả tạ

examples: He lifts dumbbells every morning to build arm strength.
The gym has dumbbells ranging from two to fifty kilograms.

definitions.meaning: sức bền thể lực và tinh thần

examples: Playing football for ninety minutes requires a lot of stamina.
Building stamina takes months of consistent training.

definitions.meaning: chiến thắng trong một trận đấu hoặc cuộc thi

examples: The team celebrated their victory with a big party.
It was a hard-fought victory against a strong opponent.

definitions.meaning: áo thi đấu thể thao

examples: Each player wore a jersey with their name and number on the back.
He bought a jersey of his favourite football player.

definitions.meaning: khoảng nghỉ, chu kỳ lặp trong bài tập ngắt quãng

examples: Interval training alternates between high and low intensity exercise.
She rests for thirty seconds between each interval.

definitions.meaning: giải đấu, liên đoàn thể thao

examples: Their club was promoted to the top league after a great season.
She plays in a local basketball league on weekends.
